design_doc: A 3D one-on-one boxing/fighting game in UE5. A muscular warrior and an armored goddess face off in an open-air medieval arena. Normal punches charge energy; at full energy the ultimate fire uppercut becomes available with flame VFX. Best-of-3 rounds, 99-second timer, side-view camera. Scene uses imported open-source Sicka Yazd medieval map. 5 motion clips per character (idle, move, punch, ultimate, hit_react) generated via MoMask and retargeted. Characters generated via Meshy API.
